policy: research authoring index only; not runtime admission

waves.focus: 2025 systematic review/meta-analysis of eight human musculoskeletal-pain studies; possible analgesic effect with substantial heterogeneity and no proof of equivalence to standard analgesics.
2026 PCOS review combining four human and four animal studies; human pooled lipids and testosterone were null, so clinical-feature signals must not be conflated with hormonal/lipid efficacy.
2024 review of 29 RCTs/1,879 participants; low-certainty nasal-symptom signals and no clear difference from antihistamines in limited comparisons; category-level only.
2024 nine-RCT/558-participant stress-anxiety meta-analysis; PSS/Hamilton-anxiety/cortisol signals with mild-moderate adverse events and uncertain long-term safety.
2025 23-RCT skin-aging meta-analysis; overall hydration/elasticity/wrinkle signals disappeared in non-industry-funded/high-quality subgroups, making funding and study quality first-class modifiers.
2024 six-RCT/339-participant obesity meta-analysis; body weight, BMI and waist outcomes were null overall, providing a direct counterweight to weight-loss claims.
2025 49-study GRADE meta-analysis of cardiovascular/metabolic risk factors; multiple pooled surrogate signals with broad heterogeneity and no clinical-event inference.
2025 RCT meta-analysis of insulin resistance/sensitivity; overall evidence did not establish meaningful HOMA-IR/fasting-insulin benefit across pomegranate products.
2025 38-RCT synthesis; oxidative-stress markers improved while CRP, IL-6 and TNF-alpha were null, separating antioxidant biomarker effects from broad anti-inflammatory claims.
2025 dose-response meta-analysis of 53 RCTs/2,306 participants; cardiometabolic risk-factor evidence remains endpoint- and preparation-specific.
2025 GRADE dose-response meta-analysis of adult blood-pressure RCTs; blood-pressure effects require dose/duration/baseline-status context and should not imply cardiovascular-event prevention.

2026 umbrella review of 16 systematic reviews/113 RCTs/7,983 participants; skin and musculoskeletal signals were more consistent than oral/cardiometabolic outcomes; category-level heterogeneity retained.
2024 16-RCT/492-participant cognition meta-analysis; memory/attention/processing-speed signals with global cognition and executive-function nulls and low-to-moderate certainty.
2025 systematic review/meta-analysis of 24 exercise studies; circulating CoQ10 increased but exercise-performance effects were limited/inconsistent—useful counterweight to ergogenic marketing.
2025 seven-small-trial mood meta-analysis; some depression-scale signals, BDI and anxiety nulls, with small samples and clinical-population heterogeneity.
2025 RCT meta-analysis of probiotics/prebiotics/synbiotics for anxiety, depression and sleep; intervention class and strain/product identity remain distinct.
2026 60-study/6,329-participant IBS review; peppermint-oil and Chinese-herbal signals coexist with limited-quality evidence and insufficient data for several plants.
2025 T2D-specific systematic review/meta-analysis of CoQ10 effects on lipids and blood pressure; disease-population and endpoint boundaries retained.
2024 24-RCT/9,660-participant dose-response cognition meta-analysis in adults >=40 without dementia; domain/time/dose trends should not become a universal cognitive-enhancement claim.
2025 systematic review/meta-analysis of placebo-controlled RCTs in healthy adults; cognitive effects remain domain-specific and the authors characterize evidence as promising but not conclusive.
2024 systematic review of 12 RCTs/703 adults; cardiometabolic effects remain short-duration and pure-OLE specific.
Seven-RCT/472-participant BP meta-analysis; modest SBP/DBP reductions with nonlinear dose/duration signals and subgroup dependence.

2025 12-week DB-RCT in 202 adults with subclinical depressive symptoms; modest depression benefit, most secondary outcomes null, sleep benefit only exploratory in a more-impaired subgroup; proprietary Affron identity retained.

2024 meta-analysis comparing saffron with SSRIs; depression/anxiety differences were nonsignificant while adverse events were fewer with saffron; direct-comparator evidence does not establish broad interchangeability.
Sleep meta-analysis across heterogeneous populations; PSQI/ISI/RSQ signals with limited long-term safety evidence and no generic dose recommendation.

2025 network meta-analysis of probiotic strains/combinations in adults with T2D; glycemic effects are strain/product and disease-population specific, and ranking does not equal head-to-head superiority.
2025 network meta-analysis of turmeric preparations for knee OA; product/formulation identity and network-comparison limitations retained.
2025 CKD-specific RCT meta-analysis of inflammatory, lipid, hematologic and anthropometric markers; disease-population surrogate evidence only.
2026 umbrella review of 45 systematic reviews/129 associations; broad multi-outcome evidence with GRADE credibility differences across endpoints.
2025 knee-OA systematic review/meta-analysis; pain/function findings remain short-term, indication-specific and preparation-sensitive.
2024 umbrella meta-analysis of prior OA meta-analyses; useful for consistency/heterogeneity assessment but not a substitute for formulation-specific RCT evidence.
2025 systematic review of 30 trials in T2D/prediabetes/metabolic syndrome; modest glycemic signals plus mechanistic microbiome readouts, with intervention classes kept separate.
2025 knee-OA RCT meta-analysis of serum inflammatory biomarkers; biomarker findings remain distinct from patient-reported pain/function efficacy.
2025 16-RCT T2D meta-analysis; FBG/HbA1c/TC/LDL signals with 2-h glucose, insulin, HOMA, TG, HDL, liver/kidney, weight and BMI nulls.
2024 30-study glycemic meta-analysis; FBS/HbA1c signals with insulin and HOMA-IR nulls and extreme heterogeneity.
2026 31-trial metabolic-disease meta-analysis; modest weight/BMI/BP/glycemic changes with central-adiposity and insulin-resistance nulls.
2025/2026 ED systematic review/meta-analysis of randomized trials; erectile-function evidence remains indication-specific and separated from testosterone/bodybuilding claims.
2025 eight-RCT/372-participant meta-analysis; SBP/DBP and waist signals with weight and BMI nulls.
2024 54-RCT/3,000-participant inflammation meta-analysis; CRP/IL-6 reductions with TNF-alpha null and high heterogeneity.
2025 umbrella review of chia meta-analyses; broad health claims graded by AMSTAR-2/GRADE, preserving low-certainty and inconsistent outcomes.
2025 systematic review/meta-analysis of moderate-high-dose astaxanthin and lipid profiles; lipid endpoints remain dose/formulation dependent.
2025 meta-analysis in overweight/obese adults; intermediate-disease-marker evidence only, with heterogeneous populations and surrogate endpoints.
2025 systematic meta-analysis of RCTs on cardiovascular/metabolic markers; multi-endpoint cardiometabolic evidence with no event-level inference.
2024 updated randomized-trial meta-analysis of anthropometric indices; weight/BMI/waist effects remain preparation/population dependent.
2025 CRP dose-response meta-analysis; inflammatory biomarker evidence remains surrogate and distinct from clinical anti-inflammatory efficacy.
2024 glycemic systematic review/meta-analysis; FBG/HbA1c/insulin evidence is limited by a small heterogeneous RCT base.
2023/2024 sex-hormone meta-analysis; FSH, SHBG, testosterone, free-androgen index and DHEAS were not significantly changed—useful endocrine counterweight.
29-RCT metabolic-syndrome meta-analysis; FPG/TG/HDL/waist/SBP signals with DBP and BMI nulls.
2025 updated 26-RCT glycemic synthesis; FBG/2hPPG/HbA1c/insulin signals with HOMA-IR null and substantial heterogeneity.
Metabolic-syndrome RCT meta-analysis of lipid and glycemic indices; disease-population and endpoint specificity retained.
2024 systematic review/meta-analysis in trained young men; maximal-intensity performance evidence is sex-, training-status-, duration-, and chronic-supplementation specific.
2025 systematic review/meta-analysis for hyperemesis gravidarum; pregnancy-specific nausea/vomiting evidence across differing ginger forms and active comparators.
2024 network meta-analysis of cranberry juice/tablets and increased fluids for UTI prevention; product form and comparator identity remain explicit.
2024/2025 PAC-dose meta-analysis; prevention signal concentrated in products providing at least a specified proanthocyanidin threshold, reinforcing composition-specificity.
International-guideline-supporting PCOS systematic review/meta-analysis; some metabolic/reproductive signals but broad outcome uncertainty and generally mild GI tolerability versus metformin.
2025 systematic review of ginger meta-analyses; umbrella-level synthesis across inflammation, T2D, oxidative stress and pregnancy nausea with indication-specific evidence kept separate.
2024 25-RCT/1,024-participant metabolic-syndrome meta-analysis; BP/FBG/TG signals with HDL null and no universal dose inference.
2026 dose-response meta-analysis of aerobic time-trial RCTs; low and moderate acute doses improved completion time, with no qualifying high-dose evidence and no dosing recommendation.
2024 CYP1A2 genotype/exercise meta-analysis; genotype appeared to modify ergogenic response, with strong caution about small CC-genotype samples.
2025 resistance-exercise meta-analysis; acute caffeine improved mean velocity/power with subgroup differences by sex and habitual use.
2025 17-RCT/971-participant GRADE review; selected BMI/creatinine/GPx/heart-rate signals but most cardiometabolic endpoints null and overall certainty very low.
2025 systematic review of lion's mane human/preclinical evidence; limited RCT cognition signals with substantial evidence-type heterogeneity.
2024 cycling-sprint meta-analysis; dietary nitrate improved time-to-peak power but not mean, peak, or minimum power—performance-domain specificity preserved.
2025 systematic review of seven interventional sleep studies; sleep evidence remains small and heterogeneous across tart-cherry products/outcomes.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of cardiopulmonary responses during maximal graded exercise; physiologic responses are exercise-test specific and distinct from performance outcomes.
2024 systematic review of expectancy/placebo effects in sport and exercise; useful context separating pharmacologic caffeine effects from expectancy effects.
2025 40-RCT review of oral supplements for photoaging; collagen/flavanol/polyphenol signals coexist with null hyaluronic-acid/lycopene/carotenoid outcomes.
2025 pharmacovigilance scoping analysis of herbal adverse-reaction signals; safety surveillance evidence only, not incidence or causal-risk estimates.
2026 systematic review of 30 RCTs/19 oral herbal interventions; high heterogeneity, with black cohosh/dong quai trials among null results.
2025 21-RCT/1,981-participant menopausal-syndrome meta-analysis; multi-herb formula and adjunctive-treatment contexts remain product specific.
2025 60-study/6,127-participant meta-analysis; modest lipid signals across heterogeneous plant-derived supplements, with soy/phytoestrogen subgroup concentration.
2026 network meta-analysis of herbal products on metabolic outcomes in MASLD; rankings remain network-level and formulation-specific.
2026 FDA CAERS disproportionality analysis; herbal/botanical and weight-loss categories carried safety signals, but spontaneous-reporting data cannot establish incidence or causality.
Updated meta-analysis of plant-derived supplements for menopausal symptoms; pooled symptom improvements coexist with heterogeneous products and generally suboptimal evidence quality.
2024 RCT meta-analysis of probiotics/prebiotics/synbiotics/FMT and related gut-microbiota interventions in MASLD; intervention classes, duration and mechanistic endpoints remain separate.
